Name: EBAGI - Vanilla Expansion for 1.6 Artisan Goods
Author: Shreedle
Description:
[b][size=4]V2.0.0 Update[/size][/b]
The mod ZIP file now has two separate packages:
-1.6+ Forage Pickles/Juice and Flower Honey
-1.4/1.5+ Artisan Goods

I also readded Juice in the new style into this mod.

The latest version of the base EBAGI mod now includes Artisan Goods for the Ginger Island items, Unmilled Rice, and Tea Leaves. I am aware that some people have been already using and might prefer my icons for these items (if you do, thank you!), so I will be keeping them for download. If you don't wish to use my 1.4 and 1.5 icons because you prefer base EBAGI's, simply delete the folder labeled "1.4 and 1.5 Expansion" inside the folder for this mod.

Qi Fruit Jelly and Qi Fruit Wine is obtainable if one makes the Artisan Good before the Quest ends.

Tea Leaf Juice, Sweet Pea Honey, and Crocus Honey exist but can only be obtained through mods such as CJB Cheat Menu, so I added them in.

If the Pickles look familiar, these are the same images that are in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15761]Wrong Artisan Good Icons[/url] mod (which allows you to obtain EBAGI images for vanilla items used to make non-typical Artisan Goods - ex. Blackberry Pickles - so if that is something you might be interested in, please check it out~.),

[b][u]To Install:[/u][/b]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2) Install [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url].
3) Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder.
Done!
[b]
[u]To Uninstall:[/u][/b]
Simply delete the folder for this mod from your Mods folder.

(Interface mod pictured in images is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url].)
